name: @test-cabinet/simple-2d
description: Vendored, prebuilt copy of @test-cabinet/simple-2d — the Simple 2D engine: the frame loop and its delta time, the letterboxed device-pixel-ratio-aware canvas fit, named input actions, the synthesized audio cue bus, asset resolution, the diagnostics overlay, and the driver-facing host interface. Vendored so this reference implementation installs and builds with a plain `npm ci` outside the monorepo; it is byte-for-byte the engine's compiled output (the engine depends on nothing), and a real run receives the same package instead as an injected `file:` dependency on the seeded engine.
